name: ren-canv
description: The engine of ren-core's drawn renderers: a retained scene of the portable primitives with its own layout, portable style, text, painting into a flat command buffer, damage, hit testing, input, editing, selection, native text entry and an accessibility mirror. ren-skia and ren-three replay its frames.

scripts.test: node scripts/types.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.json && node --import ren-core/loader --test test/*.test.js test/*.test.jsx && node --import ren-core/compiled --test test/*.test.jsx
